name: copy
statement: α} (P : Finpartition a) (h : a = b) : Finpartition b where parts

have_tree.body: P.supIndep hu hb (by simp [hbu]) (map_rel e.symm hx) ?_

name: exists_le_of_le
statement: α} {P Q : Finpartition a} (h : P ≤ Q) (hb : b ∈ Q.parts) : ∃ c ∈ P.parts, c ≤ b

have_tree.type: ∀ p ∈ P.parts, ∃ q ∈ Q.parts.erase b, p ≤ q

name: card_mono
statement: α} {P Q : Finpartition a} (h : P ≤ Q) : #Q.parts ≤ #P.parts

have_tree.type: ∀ b ∈ Q.parts, ∃ c ∈ P.parts, c ≤ b

name: sum_restrict
statement: Finpartition a) (hb : b ≤ a) {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : α → M) (hf : f ⊥ = 0) : ∑ p ∈ (P.restrict hb).parts, f p = ∑ q ∈ P.parts, f (q ⊓ b)

name: sum_combine
statement: Type*} {I : Finset ι} {s : ι → α} (P : ∀ i, Finpartition (s i)) (ha : I.SupIndep s) {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : α → M) : ∑ p ∈ (Finpartition.combine P ha).parts, f p = ∑ i ∈ I, ∑ p ∈ (P i).parts, f p

have_tree.name: hp_disj
have_tree.body: (ha.pairwiseDisjoint hi hj hij).mono ((P i).le hpi) ((P j).le hpj)

name: mem_part_iff_exists
statement: a ∈ P.part b ↔ ∃ p ∈ P.parts, a ∈ p ∧ b ∈ p
